What helps

What to include for a useful first reply.

1

The site

The URL, the platform or CMS it runs on, and roughly how big it is.

2

The symptom

What you are seeing—a drop, a plateau, a launch, slow reporting—and roughly when it started.

3

The evidence

A Search Console or analytics screenshot, if you have one. It speeds up the diagnosis a lot.

4

The goal

What success looks like for the business, and any deadline or constraint I should know about.
